Q: chart metadata (Chart.yaml) missing on helm upgrade A:

In my case, it was working the first time. I was using a cloud shell and just created templates from an Helm chart. The generated yaml files were placed in a folder with the same name as the chart name. The second time I run the templating, I got this error. I just realized it after reading jidckii answer!

Q: Which shell is it actually? A:

The builtin variable $$ holds the PID of the current shell. On the current terminal try

ps -alf -p $$

F S UID          PID    PPID  C PRI  NI ADDR SZ WCHAN  STIME TTY          TIME CMD
0 S lmc         2296    2186  0  80   0 -  2661 do_wai 09:54 pts/0    00:00:00 /bin/bash

or

ps -o pid,ppid,cmd -p $$
    PID    PPID CMD
   2296    2186 /bin/bash

Q: Autonomous mode / wrapper for Claude Code? A:

I have a project that documents a simple wrapper pattern that enables autonomous, resumable Claude Code workflows without modifying Claude itself. You can find it on my GitHub page: https://github.com/dubaixotic/Bolt.New
